name: Google Calendar public ICS
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8): 'Google: tier trusted, terms open.' (P093 rationale).

reliability.justification: Google answers authoritatively whether a public ICS feed exists; a 404 means 'private or nonexistent' and is not an existence signal (P093 cond 4).

public_ics.title: Google Calendar public ICS feed /calendar/ical/{email}/public/basic.ics
public_ics.notes: Research C0213 terms 'Google ToS (public calendar feed)'; endpoint https://calendar.google.com/calendar/ical/{urlencoded_email}/public/basic.ics. Opt-in, analyst-typed seed addresses only (P093 cond 1); SUMMARY, DESCRIPTION, LOCATION, ATTENDEE and ORGANIZER are dropped at ingestion (P093 cond 2); the raw ICS body is never cached (ttl 0 = no-store, P093 cond 3); 1 MB parse cap (max_bytes, P093 cond 4). The input is an e-mail address (PERSONAL_TYPES): personal_data_review must be recorded before default use. Used by google_calendar_ics.

notes: Seeded for batch p3-G04-1 (P093) together with the other google.com hosts. Automated but polite (min_interval 2 s): its own budget, separate from the manual-link Google hosts of google_web.
